title: M, amintattun madaukai na waya, nannade da coils

say: M, amintattun madaukai na waya, nannade da coils.
This is the video for Module 2 of Advanced Beadwork and Jewellery Making: wire work.
Waya tana juya beads da duwatsu zuwa pendants, sarƙoƙi, haɗe-haɗe da manne da kuke yi da kanku.

say: Abubuwa biyu sun yanke shawarar yadda waya ke aiki. Na farko, ma'auni, wanda ke nufin kauri. Lambobin suna gudu a baya. 18 ma'auni yana kusan 1.0 mm. 20 ma'auni yana kusan 0.8 mm. Ma'auni 26 bakin ciki ne, don murɗawa.

panel.heading: Gauge da fushi
right: Matattu mai laushi: nade da saƙa
Rabin wuya: wayoyi na kunne, manne
Lankwasawa yana ƙara wa waya ƙarfi

say: Na biyu, fushi, wanda ke nufin taurin. Matacciyar waya mai laushi don nadewa da saƙa ce. Rabin wuya yana riƙe da siffarsa, don wayoyi na kunne da manne.
Kowane lanƙwasa yana ƙara wa waya ƙarfi. Lanƙwasa wuri ɗaya sau da yawa kuma yana ɗauka, don haka ku yi kowane lanƙwasa sau ɗaya.

say: Mataki na daya. Bar kusan 4 zuwa 5 cm na waya sama da katako.

say: Mataki na biyu. Rike wayar tare da filayen sarkar hanci kamar 3 mm sama da dutsen dutsen kuma lanƙwasa ta digiri 90. Wannan tazarar mm 3 ita ce inda kayan ku za su zauna.

panel.rule: Madaukai nannade don duk abin da aka ja. Sauƙaƙe madaukai don 'yan kunne.

say: Don buɗe zoben tsalle, riƙe shi da sarƙan hancin sarƙoƙi biyu kuma karkatar da iyakar gefe, hannu ɗaya daga gare ku, ɗaya zuwa gare ku. Juya jujjuyawar don rufe shi ba tare da tazara ba.

right: Ja da iyakar zuwa cikin C

say: Kada a taɓa raba iyakar zuwa siffar C. Yana raunana zoben, kuma ba zai sake rufewa da kyau ba.

say: Ga misalin aiki. Esther a Ibadan tana haɗuwa da ƙwanƙolin dutse 8 mm tare da madaukai nannade, ga abokin ciniki wanda wuyansa ya kai cm 16.

items: Tsawon da aka gama: 16 + 2 = 18 cm

Abubuwan haɗin da ake buƙata: 16 ÷ 1.6 = 10

say: Ta ƙara 2 cm cikin sauƙi, don haka tsayin da aka gama shine 18 cm.

say: Coils suna amfani da waya mai kyau da yawa, don haka auna farko. Misali, Aisha a Kano ta nade waya 50 cm sannan ta samu 4.5 cm na nada: kusan 11.1 cm na waya cikin santimita.

say: Ajiye siririyar waya a kusurwar dama zuwa ainihin, kuma a tura coils tare kowane ƴan juyi don kada wani gibi ya nuna.

say: Kuskuren gama gari shine daidaita kink akai-akai. Zai kama daga baya a hannun abokin ciniki. Cire baya zuwa gaban kink kuma ci gaba da sabon yanki.

say: Kafin kowane yanki ya bar benci, duba shi. Sanya gilashin aminci a duk lokacin da kuka yanke.
Guda safa akan yanki. Idan ya kama, wani kaifi mai kaifi yana fitowa, don haka a saka shi ko a rubuta shi.
Danna dutsen nannade daga gaba da baya. Idan ya danna ko motsi, ƙara firam ɗin. Kuma duba kowane madauki yana rufe.

panel.heading: Tsaro da ingancin cak
items: Gilashin aminci a kunne lokacin yanke waya
Gwajin hannun jari: babu masana'anta kama
Danna dutse: babu danna, babu motsi
Kowane madauki yana tsakiya kuma yana rufe

say: Yi aiki akan jan karfe da farko. Kunna abin lanƙwasa, yi madaukai 20 da abin haɗin gwiwa, kuma gina katin samfur na coils, spirals da waya saƙa.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan ku don wannan tsarin
items: Kunna abin lanƙwasa a cikin tagulla
Maɗaukakin madauki da abin hannu mai haɗin gwiwa
Yi nada, karkace da saƙa samfurin
